purpose: Regression evidence for the compact desktop UI redesign
execution_strategy: One full suite followed by --last-failed; six passing tests were not repeated.
duration_precision: Durations are the actual Playwright console values rounded to one decimal second.

environment.isolated_benchmark_service_cleanup: The test-owned 8766 process was stopped after completion; shared 1420 and 8765 processes were not stopped.

test_selector_updates: Initial library readiness now waits for the actual open/create button or library heading, not the loading form container.
Backup destination selector uses textbox accessible-name prefix because the existing wrapper also includes the Create Backup button label.

datasets.main: Generated CC0 academic.pdf and geometry.pdf plus existing real parsed resources in the UI test library. No API responses or image assets were mocked.
datasets.parser_scope: REQUIRE_PARSE=1 verifies real persisted Docling figures/tables; existing imported PDFs may be hash-deduplicated rather than reparsed.

pagination_benchmark.images: Real PDFium crop PNG/thumbnail shared by the explicit synthetic records; not a parser accuracy dataset.

windows_dpi_scope: Geometry test uses browser deviceScaleFactor=2; Windows system display scaling is unchanged.

cases.name: real local library import, PDF selection, caption search, export and reload
real Docling figures and table editing survive export
folders, notes, tags, theme and complete backup restore use the real API

attempts.failure: Exact getByLabel for backup destination did not include the nested Create Backup button in its accessible name.

cases.name: polling server metadata updates untouched fields while retaining an unsaved note
chapter and reference corrections preserve location and survive a real save/reload
paper detail pagination can reach resource 201 in the real 1000-image gallery fixture
real PDF.js highlight and raster alignment at DPR 2, CropBox offsets, UserUnit 2 and four rotations
